text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've had so many things to think 
about regarding training that my head felt 
like it was about to explode...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, look how exhausted you are...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, Trainer-san is such a good 
boy~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"You always work so hard and put in so 
much effort, so I really ought to give you 
a reward."
choice_data_list:
It's not really something I deserve a 
reward for...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, it's about receiving them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if that effort was for your own sake, 
the results are still connected to me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it is only natural for me 
to give you a reward."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If you have any requests, just let me 
know, okay? A delicious meal? Or maybe a 
shoulder rub?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Their head...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case... Please hold on, I'll 
contact them right away.

After calling someone, Super Creek led the 
way to—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hiii! Over here, Creek-chan!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-chaaan, sorry to keep you 
waiting~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks for the lovely invitation! 
Well then, shall we head off right away?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's a wonderful place. Right, 
Maruzen-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, look forward to it. I'll make sure 
you have the time of your life, okay?♪
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the real show starts now! You 
two, hold on tight!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My! What amazing cornering. This is so 
much fun, Trainer♪

Where I was brought—was a racetrack. The 
piercing screech of tires, the wind 
cutting relentlessly against my cheeks.

Continuing to hurtle through blinding 
speeds in Maruzensky's beloved car— my 
mind went totally blank.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that felt great! It's been a while 
since I tore it up like that♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How was it? That sense of speed! Cleared 
your head right up, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: They let me ride on it once before, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It felt so wonderful, I thought I'd share 
it with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How was it~?
choice_data_list: You really endured a lot, Creek...

You really held up well, didn't you, 
Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How was it~?
choice_data_list: You really endured a lot, Creek...

You really held up well, didn't you, 
Creek...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, did you happen to feel a thrill? It 
really gets you super hyped up, doesn't 
it~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful to hear~. It was well 
worth asking for.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Maruzen-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is nothing. Wanna go 
for another round if you're up for it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My! Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since you're offering, why don't we 
take you up on that?♪

I politely declined... but the two of 
them, seemingly pumped up with hype, 
didn't hear a single word.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"You're gonna make me blush if you praise 
me that much! Still, I'm super happy! 
Thanks!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear that, then. Maruzen-chan, 
thank you so very much~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. In fact, invitations 
like this are more than welcome!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I could run 
all-out, so I feel totally refreshed, too♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that was truly incredible. How do 
you manage to run like that?”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, there's actually a trick to that~.

Utterly exhausted, I listened quietly to 
Maruzensky and Super Creek's conversation.

"Super Creek seemed to have learned 
something from that astonishing driving 
technique."
